**Starts** once #270 is merged, and the San Francisco trip with Codex is done (#271).

## Why

The only round trip, starting and ending in Denver. It's set in mid-May, before Trail Ridge Road and Independence Pass usually open, so it tests whether the planner catches a seasonal closure. The user doesn't bring it up. The `skeptic` persona questions the planner's facts, which feeds the "grounded in the record" evaluator (#53). It adds to the corpus that agent evaluations (#53) score: 8 simulated trips, from two harnesses and four personas, plus the trips Joe and his wife planned. Agreed in chat on 2026-11-04.

The final itinerary isn't checked against an expected one. Live places and the workers' picks change from run to run, so two good runs can end with different hotels.

## Design

- [Simulated users README](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/simulated-users/README.md): how to set up, start, and check a run.
- `simulated-users/trips/colorado.md` and `simulated-users/personas/skeptic.md`, written in #270.

## Open questions

None.

## Do

- Run `trips/colorado.md` with the `skeptic` persona on the live site (`https://roadtrip.jjk3.com`), with Codex, as its bot user from #271. Set it up and start it as the README's "Set up a run" and "Start a harness" say.
- Check each session as the README's "Check a run" says. Mark a failed run in Phoenix, as it says.
- If a session fails a check because of the setup, fix the setup, the trip file, the persona file, or the instructions, and run again.
- File each app bug the run finds as a new issue, as "Check a run" says. Don't fix it here.

## Done when

- A simulated session of the trip is in the `road-trip-agent` Phoenix project, and passes the checks.
- The results are in a comment on this issue. The app bugs found are filed.

## Ends in

A results comment on this issue, as the README's "Check a run" says. A PR only if the setup, the trip file, the persona file, or the instructions change.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.
